criterion: Highest mean across three historical rolling splits; same overlap and selection-bias caveats

parameters.label: Membership in next-window top-5 qualified programme IDs; never outer validation labels
parameters.features: Original 39 plus six past-category features: known flag, long/recent share, recent trend, soft category-clock affinity and lift; 45 total
parameters.candidate_pool: Same legal pool; wider candidate generation with unchanged scoring features and classifier settings
parameters.rationale: Student hypothesized mixed child/adult use of one account. Historical heavy-user Kids share varies by time of day. Test category/time interactions without claiming viewer identities or using future category labels.
parameters.selection: Mean of the same three historical rolling MAP@5 values; report coverage, all split scores and tradeoffs
parameters.unknown_future_categories: Unknown if no pre-cutoff metadata; do not read category from future schedule
